name: Honda RC51 (RVT1000R)
engine: 999 cc liquid-cooled 90-degree V-twin, fuel injected, gear-driven cams
intro: Honda's V-twin superbike. Gear-driven cams, a big fuel injection system and a rear shock worth checking.

F: Check the regulator/rectifier and its connector. Heat damage there is a common cause of charging problems on these.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
